desc: The SOG Adventurer LB is built to be a sturdy, reliable companion for all of life's adventures both big and small. The Adventurer LB's three and a half inch blade is made from 5Cr15MoV, a tough piece of steel that can handle everything a knife is supposed to endure. The handle is made from 30% glass-filled nylon, a high strength plastic especially well suited to knife handles for its strength and accessible price point. The Adventurer brings remarkably tough materials to your pocket without weighing you down or breaking the bank — after all, the heaviest thing in your pocket is supposed to be your wallet.
